paragraphs: The Pier Trip Plan, posted by Leo. Do you like trains? I like trains, and I love boats. This trip has both, so please read the plan. We are all very excited, and Teacher Kim is excited, too.

The trip is on Saturday, the thirtieth of January. We are meeting at the town station at half past eight. The train leaves from the first platform at nine o'clock. The journey takes one hour. We will sit together on the train. I will sit next to the window. We arrive at the sea station at ten o'clock. Then we walk to the pier together.

On the pier, every visitor can watch the boats for free. At eleven o'clock, a small boat takes us along the coast. The boat ride is half an hour long. We will wave to the people on the beach. The wind will be cool and fresh. Mia is going to take a group selfie at the end of the pier. I will draw the boats for my cartoon. We are having lunch at twelve o'clock, and we are going home at two o'clock.

Please pack a small bag with a bottle of water and a lunch. We cannot take big luggage on a small boat. Wear a hat, and bring a light jacket for the wind. Wear shoes that stay on your feet, because the pier can be wet. Bring some money for a snack, but not too much. My jacket is red, and it is very light. I will bring my pencils myself, because my pencils are special.

Sometimes a train has a delay. If that happens, we will wait on the platform. Teacher Kim will send a message to every parent. She already has the train tickets. She keeps them in a blue folder. We will not leave the station without her. The station has a small shop. We can buy water there. The parents sign a note, and they give it to Teacher Kim on Thursday. I hope that the weather is good. Which part of the trip do you like best?
